entities.summary: Jagdish Natwarlal Bhagwati is an Indian-born naturalized American economist and trade theorist. He is a University Professor of economics and law at Columbia University and a Senior Fellow in International Economics at the Council on Foreign Relations. He has made contributions to international trade theory and economic development.
